name: mybusiness-implementor
description: MyBusiness CRM implementation toolkit: a bundled MCP connection to your own CRM (Application Id + an API key you generate yourself) + product knowledge base + no-code implementation skills (entities, pages, table views, dashboards, reports, triggers, form rules, users & permissions, terminology, price quotes, data import, web2lead, multi-select & cascading fields, SLA, settings pages, CSAT surveys, fit-gap analysis). Hebrew-first Israeli CRM.

application_id.title: Application Id
application_id.description: From your CRM's development environment: the arrow next to your user name -> Development environment -> Databases -> your database -> Settings -> Application Id (Copy). Step-by-step with screenshots: the myb-p-getting-started skill.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: On the same Settings screen, under API Keys: press 'Add Key', then Save, and copy the key. It grants full access to that database - treat it like a password, and press Revoke on that row to withdraw it.
